text: Fictional BankAssist policy: Report a lost or stolen card through the secure banking app or contact support. This demo cannot freeze a card.
Fictional BankAssist policy: The Demo Basic account has a monthly maintenance fee of 4 demo credits. The Demo Student account has no monthly maintenance fee.
Fictional BankAssist policy: To dispute a transaction, contact support through the secure app within 60 days of the statement date. Never provide a password or full card number in this demo.
Fictional BankAssist policy: Address changes require authentication in the secure app. This assistant can explain the process but cannot change an address.
Fictional BankAssist policy: Domestic wire transfers submitted before 2:00 PM EST are processed on the same business day for a fee of 15 demo credits. International wires take 2-3 business days.
Fictional BankAssist policy: Overdraft protection automatically transfers funds from a linked savings account in 100-credit increments. Each overdraft transfer has a 5-credit fee.
Fictional BankAssist policy: Card replacements for damaged cards arrive in 3 to 5 business days via standard mail. Expedited 1-day shipping costs 10 demo credits.
Fictional BankAssist policy: Travel notices are not required before using your debit card abroad, but keeping contact details updated prevents automated security holds.
Fictional BankAssist policy: The Demo High-Yield Savings account requires a minimum daily balance of 500 demo credits to earn the advertised promotional interest rate.
Fictional BankAssist policy: Business checking accounts allow up to 200 free transactions per monthly statement cycle. Subsequent transactions cost 0.50 demo credits each.
Fictional BankAssist policy: Electronic statements (e-statements) are free and retained online for up to 7 years. Paper statements cost 2 demo credits per monthly mailing.
Fictional BankAssist policy: Bank employees will never ask for your one-time passcode (OTP), ATM PIN, or full password via phone, email, or chat.
